name: Devin
one_liner: Cognition's autonomous AI software engineer (Devin Cloud) with a documented v3 REST API, official MCP server and CLI.
auth_notes: cog_-prefixed Service User API keys or Personal Access Tokens sent as Authorization: Bearer. Service user created in Settings > Devin API; keys expire (default 30 days).
access_notes: Self-serve service user provisioning for Teams/standard orgs; Devin Cloud (which the API drives) is listed from the Pro plan ($20/mo) up, not the Free plan. Enterprise API scope (cross-org analytics, audit) is for enterprise customers. Plan-by-plan API gating not fully legible in the fetched pricing table.

buildability.rationale: Documented v3 REST API (organization and enterprise scopes, 200+ reference pages) with self-serve service-user keys, but requires a paid Devin org; enterprise endpoints need enterprise plan.

disputes.why: Core v3 REST API overview exists and was fetchable.
API llms index lists about 237 v3 reference pages across organization and enterprise scopes.
Pricing page lists Devin Cloud under Pro and above; API keys come from an org's Settings.
Migration guide mentions cursor pagination in v3.
Core API gate is paid plan; enterprise-only for cross-org endpoints.

identity.quote: The Devin API enables you to integrate Devin into your applications, automate workflows, and build powerful tools.

auth.quote: All API credentials use the `cog_` prefix format.

access.quote: Go to **Settings > Devin API** in your organization and open the **Service users** tab

api_surface.quote: new endpoint URLs, cursor pagination, and v2 enterprise equivalents.

buildability.quote: Use **service users** with role-based access control for secure, auditable API access.
